## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 14 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/pid-liveness.args`, which this bug owns.

`rebar._store.lock_owner._pid_alive` (`src/rebar/_store/lock_owner.py:253-274`) returns True whenever signal 0 is not a liveness probe (`_signal_zero_probes_liveness`), which is the Windows case. So a dead holder reads as `pid_state=unverified-live`, stamps are never proven stale, and dead-owner reclamation falls back to the exclusive-leg proof or the age ceiling. Tests asserting a dead holder is detected fail (`pid_state=not-running` expected, `unverified-live` received), and `tests/interfaces/store/test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py::_dead_owner_stamp` loops `while lock_owner._pid_alive(pid)` until pytest's timeout kills the process (serial runs 44676069202 and 44678245519 died there and at `test_stale_lock_reclaim_write.py`).

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` with origin/main `717c50f8b33` code plus a selection-only workflow change: run 44665461131 (the 242 `unclassified.args` entries; 48 passed, 194 failed or errored) and run 44681457334 (the 194, xdist, JUnit XML with full tracebacks). Both 2026-11-19 PST.

Modules:
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py` (1)
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_stale_lock_reclaim_write.py` (1)
- `tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py` (6)
- `tests/unit/store/test_stamped_lock.py` (2)
- `tests/unit/test_lock_stale_reclaim.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_lock_timeout_names_holder_7084.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_mcp_idle_sync.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py` (1)

## Approach
Decide between a Windows liveness probe (`OpenProcess` + `GetExitCodeProcess`, which can prove a pid gone) and skipping these tests on Windows with the documented conservative behaviour. Either way the deselected lines leave `pid-liveness.args`.

## Scope
Test or product code for the listed modules, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/pid-liveness.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `pid-liveness.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `pid-liveness.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.

file_impact.reason: remove each line as its test is fixed
